text: Hello, boys and girls, it's time for class.Please get your student's book, notebook and worksheet ready.请准备好你的课本、笔记本以及这一课时的任务单。Shall we get started?Do you remember this picture?Some of the grade 8 students at Mayfield School came together to discuss starting a school newspaper.To make sure the newspaper goes smoothly, they established a newspaper committee.A committee is a group of people chosen to do a particular job, 委员会。Can you make a guess what happened after the committee had the first meeting?Any ideas, Nathan?I think they held some other meetings to talk about the publishing of the newspaper.Good.The first meeting left them some important issues to discuss.Benson, what do you think?I guess maybe they published the newspaper successfully after the meetings.Good guess.The first edition of the school newspaper came out two months ago.Here, the first edition means the first copies of their newspaper.第一期报纸。To come out means to be available.That is to say, the readers could buy and read the newspapers.Come out.出版,发行。To keep the headmaster updated on their progress, now on behalf of the committee, Arthur is to write a progress report to the headmaster.A progress report is a written record of what has been done and what is left to do on the project.过程性报告。Suppose you are Arthur, what will you write about in the progress report?I will write about the publishing of the first edition.I will tell the headmaster that the first edition has come out.Besides, I will probably write about what the readers think of the first edition.Good point.That is the feedback from the readers.Benson, what will you write about?Maybe I will include what we plan to do in the report as well.You will write about future plans.Very good.Since this is the first time for Arthur to write a progress report, it is also necessary to let the headmaster know the regular activities of the committee.But what are the regular activities of a newspaper committee?For example, how do the students make decisions and get things moving?I think the most important activities are meetings.The committee members have made it a rule to hold regular meetings.Suppose you are Arthur, what will you write to tell the headmaster about your regular meetings?Eva, what do you come up with?I will tell the headmaster how often we hold meetings.How often do the students meet?Do you remember what Arthur wrote at the end of the first meeting report?We arranged to have the next meeting in one week's time.They meet once a week or every week.What else will you tell him in your report?I will tell him when and where we usually meet.Great.Suppose they usually meet after school in one of the classrooms.You can also include the information of how long the meetings usually last.Anything else about the regular meetings?Nathan, I will write about what we usually do at the meetings.For example, we brainstorm, have heated discussions on different topics, and make decisions on important matters.Excellent.You tell him how the committee works.Don't forget to tell the headmaster about the committee members and their duties.I think we have covered most of the things about the regular meetings.Please take out your worksheet.Suppose you are Arthur.Write the first part of the progress report, the regular meetings.By the way, what tense do we use to talk about the regular activities?We use the simple present tense.Please cover the information listed on the screen.It is task one on your worksheet.Okay.This is Benson's writing.Does Benson cover most of the information of when, where, what and who?Does he write in the simple present tense?I think so.Good job, Benson.Let's move on to talk about what the committee has done.The first edition came out two months ago, right?What happened then?Look, they received a letter from one of the readers, Jimmy.Please read the letter and think about the questions.Okay, what did Jimmy think of the first edition?He thought it was interesting but too expensive.He mentioned that some students complained about the price.What suggestions did he make in his letter?He suggested that they should charge no more than one yuan.To charge means to ask for money.He also suggested that they should have a health section and include articles about student health.What's more, he thought they should organize a health competition.The feedback from the readers is something important to record in the report.Would you please write about the first edition and summarize the feedback from the readers?Since these are past events, you should write in the past tense.It is task two on your worksheet.When you write, you can refer to the information on the screen.When you write, you can refer to the information on the screen中文字幕提供 by like.请在您的工作项目中订阅桌子,并将两个报告的缘分标准备好。你完成了吗?让我们来看看。你可能觉得很难知道他们有什么共通点和什么不同点。你怎么能够清楚地准备好这些东西呢?你可以像这个样描述一幅图案。中间的部分显示了两个报告的共同点。他们两个人使用过去的语言来写述过去的事件,使用过去的语言来写述其他人的说话,并写出决定。这些缘分很简单,因为这些缘分分开放在不同的地方。这是一个更好的方法来做比较,对吧?今天,我们已经学会了如何写出一份进步报告。请在您的工作项目中写述,并写在您的工作项目中。今天就到此为止。很期待再次见到您。
